1. Everyday Food, Juice, or Sauce Stains

Mix **1 cup of warm water**, **1 tbsp of white vinegar** , and **1/4 tsp of mild, clear dish soap** . Spray or dab it onto the stain, let it sit for a few minutes, and blot with a clean cloth until the stain lifts.[](https://thatcarpetguy.com.au/blog/how-to-get-old-stains-out-of-carpet-quickly-and-easily/) [[1]](https://thatcarpetguy.com.au/blog/how-to-get-old-stains-out-of-carpet-quickly-and-easily/)[[2]](https://carpetexchange.com/flooring-school/how-to-remove-stains-from-carpet)

2. Coffee, Tea, or Wine Stains

First, absorb as much fresh liquid as possible with a dry towel. Next, mix **1 cup of warm water with 1 tbsp of dish soap** . Apply the mixture to the stain, blot gently, and rinse thoroughly with cold water.[](https://carpetsalescentre.com.au/how-to-clean-carpet-stains/) [[1]](https://carpetsalescentre.com.au/how-to-clean-carpet-stains/)[[2]](https://www.coles.com.au/recipes-inspiration/home-ideas/get-rid-of-carpet-stains)[[3]](https://carpetexchange.com/flooring-school/how-to-remove-stains-from-carpet)

3. Grease, Butter, or Oil Stains

Liberally apply baking soda or cornflour to the spot to draw out the oil. Let it sit for 15-30 minutes, then vacuum. If a mark remains, lightly dab rubbing alcohol onto a cloth and gently press it into the fibers to dissolve the grease.[](https://carpetsalescentre.com.au/how-to-clean-carpet-stains/) [[1]](https://carpetsalescentre.com.au/how-to-clean-carpet-stains/)[[2]](https://www.coles.com.au/recipes-inspiration/home-ideas/get-rid-of-carpet-stains)4. Stubborn or Old Stains For tough-to-lift or dried stains, mix **1 cup of hydrogen peroxide (3%) with 1/2 tsp of dish soap** . Lightly dab the solution onto the stain, let it sit for 5-10 minutes, and blot up with a clean towel.  
*Note: Always patch-test hydrogen peroxide on a hidden area of carpet first, as it has natural bleaching properties.* [](https://thatcarpetguy.com.au/blog/how-to-get-old-stains-out-of-carpet-quickly-and-easily/) [[1]](https://thatcarpetguy.com.au/blog/how-to-get-old-stains-out-of-carpet-quickly-and-easily/)[[2]](https://carpetexchange.com/flooring-school/how-to-remove-stains-from-carpet)[[3]](https://www.coles.com.au/recipes-inspiration/home-ideas/get-rid-of-carpet-stains)[[4]](https://therugdecor.com/blogs/blog/clean-coffee-from-rug)[[5]](https://www.choice.com.au/home-and-living/laundry-and-cleaning/carpet-cleaning/articles/how-to-get-stains-out-of-carpet)5. Pet Messes (Vomit or Urine)First, scrape up any solids, then blot the liquid completely. Sprinkle a generous amount of baking soda over the area to neutralize odors.
